1981-2415-3641-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3641-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

333-4050-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4050-8207.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Repeat.

955-2105-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

728-2060-3693-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
728-2060-3693-5544-6431.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

4247-4677-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1418-3821-3859.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}.
1418-3821-3859.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying its mana cost.
When Cavern Harpy enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-2452-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a Zombie card in hand or in your graveyard.
598-2452-5231.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast a Zombie from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Zombie
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4390-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
392-4390-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi and Ravenous Robots triggers, adding {R} and creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

1367-6568-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Sanar. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-6568-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

250-779-1479-5411-6529.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5411-6529.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

277-280-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
277-280-5702-6850.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness, with a +1/+1 counter on it and with power 3 or greater

1336-1978-5517.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat

1315-1850-1863.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1315-1850-1863.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1580-4871-5542-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

813-957-3556.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
813-957-3556.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

890-1029-5028.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Palladium Myr.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
890-1029-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

2085-4613-5329.easyPrerequisites:
You control a nontoken Merfolk and at least one additional creature that each have a +1/+1 counter on them.
Kelpie Guide exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
2085-4613-5329.description:
Activate the nontoken Merfolk using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Merfolk's ability, untapping the other creature.
Activate the other creature using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping the nontoken Merfolk.
Repeat.

413-2835-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-2835-6249--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

3940-4113-5851.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {2}, tapping Stormsplitter, and tapping Caetus.
Haze of Rage's Storm ability and each Stormsplitter triggers.
Resolve Haze of Rage's Storm ability, creating a copy of it for each spell cast before it this turn and resolving all those copies.
Resolve each Stormsplitter's trigger, creating a token copy of each one.
Haze of Rage resolves, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3} and tapping one token copy of Stormsplitter.
Repeat steps 2 through 5.
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {2} and tapping two token copies of Stormsplitter.
Repeat steps 2 through 5.
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by tapping four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Repeat steps 2 through 5.
Repeat from step 10.

1742-2097-5742-5743.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart, adding {B}.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-3113-5368.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3113-5368.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

291-1270-4659.description:
Activate Myr Matrix by paying {5}, creating three 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing the Myrs, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr tokens.

1621-5291.description:
Cast Cursed Mirror by paying {2}{R}.
Choose to have Cursed Mirror enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel with haste.
When Cursed Mirror enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Cursed Mirror.
Repeat from step 2.

184-2557-4682.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
184-2557-4682.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-2557-4682.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens due to Parallel Lives.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

1548-4034-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Yore-Tiller Nephilim does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
1548-4034-5256.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Port Razer from your graveyard onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with Port Razer and Yore-Tiller Nephilim.
Port Razer triggers, untapping each creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Port Razer, causing target player to mill cards equal to Port Razer's power.
Repeat each combat phase.

1558-2334-4231-4772-4979.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Gilded Goose.
Gilded Goose leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Soulherder.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Gilded Goose trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

91-1656-4050-4068-4170.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Necrotic Ooze undying until end of turn.
If Necrotic Ooze has any +1/+1 counters, activate it using Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Necrotic Ooze, adding {B}.
Necrotic Ooze dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.
You may also use the infinite Inkling tokens to use Fain's first ability for infinite +1/+1 counters.

1414-1661-4195-4574.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lotus Petal from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.
